items.quote: About midnight will I go out into the midst of Egypt: And all the firstborn in the land of Egypt shall die, from the first born of Pharaoh that sitteth upon his throne, even unto the firstborn of the maidservant that is behind the mill; and all the firstborn of beasts.
items.claim: At midnight, God will cause the death of all firstborn creatures in Egypt, spanning from the Pharaoh's heir to servants' children to livestock
